caption: The image depicts a piece of fabric with an embroidered floral design. The composition features three large flowers in the lower half, each with multiple petals in shades of red, pink, cream, dark blue, and green, along with yellow accents on some of the petals and leaves. The stems, embroidered in brown and green, curve upwards and outwards from the center, branching into several smaller stems that each hold buds or small flowers. In the upper right portion, there is a prominent blue and yellow flower, and throughout the design, there are smaller pink, red, or yellow buds. The fabric background is a light beige or off-white color, and there are some unfinished areas and frayed edges at the bottom, where stitching appears to be incomplete or the fabric is worn. The overall effect is of a naturalistic arrangement of flowers and foliage.
title: Bedspread (Detail)
